metadata.description: DevOps and cloud-operations plugins for AI agents. Agent plugins bind skills, commands, hooks, and MCP servers to a named specialist agent; vertical plugins apply skills to the main agent; partner-built plugins wrap third-party integrations.

plugins.name: aws-iac-engineer
plugins.description: Authors, validates, deploys, and troubleshoots AWS infrastructure-as-code: CDK, CloudFormation, AWS Blocks, and CodePipeline/CodeBuild/CodeDeploy CI/CD, with cfn-lint/cfn-guard validation and stack failure diagnosis.

plugins.name: aws-platform-engineer
plugins.description: Provisions and operates the AWS runtime platform: EC2 and Auto Scaling, EKS/ECS/Fargate containers, VPC and edge networking, storage, serverless compute, and messaging/streaming services.

plugins.name: aws-sre-agent
plugins.description: Site-reliability agent for AWS workloads: CloudWatch metrics, logs, alarms and Logs Insights, Application Signals SLOs, X-Ray/ADOT traces, CloudTrail change history, Amazon Managed Prometheus, and AWS Support case escalation.

plugins.name: aws-cloud-security-engineer
plugins.description: Cloud security and identity engineer: IAM policies, roles and trust relationships, Security Hub/GuardDuty/Inspector/Macie findings, Secrets Manager safe-handling, Cognito authentication, and Well-Architected security posture checks.

plugins.name: aws-finops-agent
plugins.description: Cloud financial-operations agent: cost and usage analysis, anomaly detection, budgets, Savings Plans and Reserved Instance evaluation, Compute Optimizer right-sizing, CUR queries, and service pricing estimates.

plugins.name: aws-solutions-architect
plugins.description: Solutions architect for AWS: evidence-backed Well-Architected Framework reviews across all six pillars, generative-AI and ML architectures on Bedrock and SageMaker, and correct AWS SDK usage (boto3, JS v3, Swift).

plugins.name: aws-agentcore-engineer
plugins.description: Builds, deploys, and operates AI agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: Strands/LangGraph scaffolding, Gateway and MCP tools, memory, Cedar policies, evaluations, trace debugging, and production hardening.

plugins.name: aws-data-engineer
plugins.description: Data-lake and analytics engineer: S3 Tables/Iceberg, Glue connections and Data Catalog, Athena and Redshift queries, ingestion pipelines, S3 Vectors, OpenSearch, and MWAA (Airflow) authoring, testing, debugging, and upgrades.

plugins.name: aws-devsecops-agent
plugins.description: Drives AWS DevOps Agent and AWS Security Agent: incident root-cause investigations, release-readiness reviews and UAT, code and diff security scans, threat modeling, penetration tests, and finding remediation.

plugins.name: aws-startup-advisor
plugins.description: Stage-aware AWS guidance for startups: architecture and cost advice, project scaffolding, Azure/GCP/Heroku-to-AWS migrations, LLM SDK rewrites to Bedrock, agent runtime selection, DevOps Agent operations, and AWS Activate offers.

plugins.name: aws-location-engineer
plugins.description: Adds geospatial features with Amazon Location Service: maps, geocoding and reverse geocoding, routing and service areas, places search, authentication setup, and SDK integration.

plugins.name: aws-amplify-engineer
plugins.description: Builds and deploys full-stack web and mobile apps with AWS Amplify Gen 2: Cognito auth, AppSync/DynamoDB data models, S3 storage, functions, and the Amplify AI Kit.

plugins.name: aws-serverless-engineer
plugins.description: Designs, builds, deploys, and debugs serverless applications: Lambda (incl. durable functions, managed instances, MicroVMs), API Gateway, Step Functions, and SAM/CDK deployment with template validation.

plugins.name: aws-modernization-agent
plugins.description: Migrates and modernizes codebases with AWS Transform: .NET Framework to .NET 8/10, mainframe COBOL to Java, VMware to EC2, SQL Server to Aurora, language and AWS SDK upgrades, and continuous tech-debt remediation.

plugins.name: aws-codebase-documentor
plugins.description: Analyzes codebases and generates structured technical documentation with source-of-truth citations and architecture views, optimized for AWS workloads built with CDK, CloudFormation, and Terraform.

plugins.name: aws-database-engineer
plugins.description: Database engineer for the AWS portfolio: chooses the right engine, designs schemas, runs queries and migrations, and operates Aurora DSQL, Aurora/RDS, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, ElastiCache/MemoryDB, Neptune, Keyspaces, and Timestream.

plugins.name: aws-deployment-agent
plugins.description: Takes an application from code to running on AWS: analyzes the codebase, recommends an architecture with cost estimates, generates and deploys IaC (incl. Elastic Beanstalk), and produces validated draw.io architecture diagrams.

plugins.name: aws-sagemaker-engineer
plugins.description: End-to-end Amazon SageMaker AI engineer: use-case planning, model selection, dataset evaluation and transformation, SFT/DPO/RLVR/RLAIF fine-tuning, evaluation, deployment, and HyperPod cluster, node, NCCL, and performance debugging.

plugins.name: aws-essentials
plugins.description: Foundation skills for any AWS work on the main agent: sign-in and credential setup, correct AWS SDK usage for Python (boto3), JavaScript v3, and Swift, plus the managed AWS MCP server and AWS Knowledge documentation search.

plugins.name: aws-infrastructure-as-code
plugins.description: Author, validate, deploy, and troubleshoot AWS infrastructure as code directly in the main agent: CDK, CloudFormation (cfn-lint/cfn-guard), AWS Blocks, CodePipeline/CodeBuild/CodeDeploy CI/CD, and guided launches.

plugins.name: aws-compute
plugins.description: EC2 skills for the main agent: choosing compute, launching instances with best practices, instance profiles, Auto Scaling, and EC2 Image Builder pipelines.

plugins.name: aws-containers
plugins.description: Container skills for the main agent: EKS, ECS, Fargate, ECR, and App Runner design and troubleshooting, with the EKS and ECS MCP servers (read-only) and Finch for building and pushing images.

plugins.name: aws-networking
plugins.description: Networking and content-delivery skills for the main agent: production VPCs, endpoints, peering, Transit Gateway, Site-to-Site VPN, Direct Connect, Route 53, CloudFront, WAF, Shield Advanced, and network monitoring, with the AWS Network MCP server.

plugins.name: aws-storage
plugins.description: Storage skills for the main agent: choosing between S3, EBS, EFS, FSx, and S3 Files, securing S3 buckets, and troubleshooting EFS and S3 Files mounts and performance.

plugins.name: aws-databases
plugins.description: Database skills for the main agent: engine selection and service-specific guidance for Aurora (PostgreSQL, MySQL, DSQL), RDS (open source, Oracle, SQL Server, Db2), DynamoDB, DocumentDB, ElastiCache, Keyspaces, Neptune, and Timestream for InfluxDB, with read-only database MCP servers and opt-in connectors.

plugins.name: aws-serverless
plugins.description: Serverless skills for the main agent: Lambda (durable functions, managed instances, MicroVMs, timeouts, VPC egress), API Gateway stages and custom domains, Step Functions, and EventBridge, with the read-only AWS Serverless MCP server.

plugins.name: aws-messaging-and-streaming
plugins.description: Messaging and streaming skills for the main agent: SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Amazon MQ, Kinesis Data Streams, MSK (incl. migrations), Managed Service for Apache Flink, and customer messaging with SES, SMS/voice, and WhatsApp, plus the SNS/SQS and Amazon MQ MCP servers.

plugins.name: aws-analytics
plugins.description: Analytics skills for the main agent: data lakes on S3 Tables/Iceberg, Glue Data Catalog and connections, Athena and Redshift (incl. migrations), OpenSearch, S3 Vectors, Clean Rooms, MWAA (Airflow), and system-table queries, with data-processing, Redshift, S3 Tables, and Spark troubleshooting/upgrade MCP servers.

plugins.name: aws-observability
plugins.description: Observability skills for the main agent: CloudWatch metrics, logs, alarms and notifications, Application Signals, X-Ray, multi-Region CloudTrail, and application-failure troubleshooting, with CloudWatch, Application Signals, CloudTrail, and Prometheus MCP servers.

plugins.name: aws-security-identity
plugins.description: Security and identity skills for the main agent: least-privilege IAM, Security Hub/GuardDuty/Inspector findings, Cognito authentication, and Secrets Manager best practices, with read-only IAM, Well-Architected security, and AWS Security Agent MCP servers and the secret-safety hook.

plugins.name: aws-resilience
plugins.description: Resilience skills for the main agent: Resilience Hub assessments (single and multi-account), Fault Injection Service experiments, ARC Region switch and recovery controller, resilience lifecycle, and resilience program design.

plugins.name: aws-cost-optimization
plugins.description: Cost skills for the main agent: Cost Explorer analysis, anomalies, budgets, Savings Plans and Reserved Instances, Compute Optimizer right-sizing, and pricing estimates, with the Billing and Cost Management and Pricing MCP servers.

plugins.name: aws-ai-ml
plugins.description: Generative AI and ML skills for the main agent: Amazon Bedrock models, agents, knowledge bases, and guardrails, plus AWS AI/ML service selection and SageMaker AI, with the read-only SageMaker AI MCP server.

plugins.name: aws-well-architected
plugins.description: Evidence-backed AWS Well-Architected Framework reviews across all six pillars on the main agent, with AWS Knowledge and the Well-Architected security MCP server.

plugins.name: aws-migration
plugins.description: Migration skills for the main agent: AWS Transform modernization (.NET, mainframe, VMware, SQL Server, language and SDK upgrades) and DMS Schema Conversion for heterogeneous database migrations.

plugins.name: aws-web-and-mobile
plugins.description: Full-stack web and mobile skills for the main agent: AWS Amplify Gen 2 apps (auth, data, storage, functions, hosting), with the read-only AWS AppSync MCP server.

plugins.name: aws-marketplace-seller
plugins.description: AWS Marketplace seller skills for the main agent: integrating SaaS, container, and AMI products with AWS Marketplace metering.

plugins.name: aws-end-user-computing
plugins.description: Amazon WorkSpaces skills for the main agent: setting up and operating agent access to WorkSpaces desktops.

plugins.name: aws-quantum-computing
plugins.description: Amazon Braket skills for the main agent: building, simulating, and running quantum circuits and hybrid jobs on Braket devices.

plugins.name: terraform
plugins.description: HashiCorp's official Terraform skills: HCL style, module refactoring, Terraform tests, search and bulk import, Stacks, Terraform policy (including Sentinel conversion), Azure Verified Modules, and provider development with the Plugin Framework (resources, actions, ephemeral resources, configuration, SDKv2 migration, docs, and acceptance tests).
